name: Plasma One
summary: Plasma One is a stablecoin account and Visa card from Plasma. You hold USDT, spend it wherever Visa is accepted in 180+ countries, and earn 2% to 4% cashback paid in XPL depending on your tier. The free Lite tier carries a 1% FX markup, while Core (US$199/year or a 20,000 XPL lock) and Platinum (a 100,000 XPL lock) cut it to 0.5% and 0%.

fees.atm: Not published (ATM withdrawals earn no cashback)
fees.topup: No Plasma fee; partner fees for FX and bank withdrawals are shown in the app

availabilityNotes: Plasma does not publish a full list of supported countries. Its terms name the account providers for US residents (Bridge Building Inc.) and EEA residents (Bridge Building Sp.), so those regions are listed here; residents elsewhere may be served by Bridge's global entity. People subject to US, UK or EU sanctions are excluded. The card is issued by Rain, a Visa Principal Member, and can be used wherever Visa is accepted in 180+ countries. Confirm eligibility in the app.

kyc.notes: Identity verification is required in the app before you get a card. You must be 18+ (or the age of majority), live where Plasma One is offered and not be subject to US, UK or EU sanctions. One card account per person.

pros: Up to 4% base cashback, plus boosted rates on AI spending and flights on paid tiers
Platinum covers the Visa FX fee
Apple Pay and Google Pay supported (region dependent)
Optional yield on stablecoin balances in the Plasma ecosystem
cons: Cashback is paid in XPL, a volatile token
1% FX markup on the free Lite tier
Core costs US$199/year and Platinum requires locking 100,000 XPL for 12 months with no early unlock
ATM fees and spending limits are not published
Yield comes from on-chain opportunities with DeFi risk and no deposit insurance
howToGet: Download the Plasma One app (iOS or Android).
Create an account and complete identity verification in the app.
Use the instant virtual card, or order a physical card where available.
Add the card to Apple Pay or Google Pay (where available) and choose a tier: Lite is free; Core and Platinum add cashback and lower FX fees.

faq.question: What is Plasma One?
faq.answer: Plasma One is a stablecoin account with a Visa card from Plasma. You hold USDT, spend it wherever Visa is accepted, and earn cashback paid in XPL.

faq.question: How much does Plasma One cost?
faq.answer: Lite is free. Core costs US$199 a year or a 12-month lock of 20,000 XPL. Platinum requires locking 100,000 XPL for 12 months and cannot be bought with cash; locked XPL cannot be unlocked early.

faq.question: What cashback does Plasma One pay?
faq.answer: 2% on Lite, 3% on Core and 4% on Platinum, paid in XPL. Core adds 5% on AI spending (on up to US$500 a month) and Platinum adds 10% on AI spending and up to US$600 a year back on flights. ATM withdrawals earn no cashback.

faq.question: What FX fee does Plasma One charge?
faq.answer: A 1% markup on Lite, 0.5% on Core and 0% on Platinum, where Plasma covers the Visa FX fee. Partner fees for FX and bank withdrawals are shown in the app before you confirm.

faq.question: Is Plasma One available in the US?
faq.answer: Yes. Plasma's terms name Bridge Building Inc. as the account provider for US residents, and EEA residents are served by Bridge Building Sp. Plasma does not publish a full country list, so confirm eligibility in the app.
